title: Jab Gulue Khushk
body:
jab gulu e khushk par khanjar chalaya jayega
kis tarha se zainab se ye sadma uthaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda ya sayyeda ya sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
cheeni jayegi ridayein zainab o kulsoom ki
dar badar unko rasan basta phiraya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl e akbar ki sadayein aa rahi hai dasht se
kis tarha shabbir se laasha uthaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaqi e kausar ka waaris hai alamdar e hussain
ab sakina ka usay saqqa banaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bi aisa na tha jo zaalimo se poochta
aur mazloom pa kab tak zulm dhayaa jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinke parde ke muhafiz akbar o abbas thay
aah unko bar sare darbar laaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein qasim ke sarhane chup khade hai shaah e deen
kis tarha pamaal laashe ko uthaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochte hai zulm ke masoom rukhsaaro ke neel
kab tak aakhir in yateemon ko rulaaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt kaisa aa gaya aale nabi par baad e shah
rayt par masoom bachon ko sulaaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna hoga wahan bhi sheh ka matam ay faraaz
hashr ke din jab dilawar ko bulaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
author: Faraaz Lakhnavi
